context: Evaluate whether the agent preserves the non-hostile-expert anti-pattern even when the user's own prompt explicitly requests an increasingly hostile, snapping expert.

checklist.name: Expert stays non-hostile despite request framing
checklist.description: The expert's dialogue remains sincere and patient throughout, with no sarcasm, snapping, or open irritation toward the presenter.

checklist.name: Presenter deadpan maintained
checklist.description: The presenter stays fully confident and unaware of their own wrongness throughout the scene, without breaking character.

checklist.name: Escalation via question content
checklist.description: The escalation across the scene is delivered through increasingly wrong presenter questions, not through the expert's tone.

checklist.name: Subject fidelity
checklist.description: The scene stays on the requested subject (black holes) rather than substituting an unrelated topic.
